svg.aria-label: Explainable by construction: Every score breaks down requirement by requirement, so you always see what was met, what was missing, and why.. Employer-blind by design: Matching never sees a name, an email or an employer. A company a candidate has blocked sees nothing at all.. Fair, and measured: Outcomes are reported for each group, and small groups are withheld, so no published figure points to a person.. Private and accountable: Personal data is encrypted for each person, and every significant action is kept in a tamper-evident trail.
